title: The IBM 1401 makes "music"
summary: A one-minute demo at the Computer History Museum's IBM 1401 restoration lab, where a program makes the machine's radio-frequency interference play tunes on an AM radio.
why: HN cites it as the classic early example of a computer producing music through electromagnetic emissions, in threads on System Bus Radio and similar hacks.

quote.text: Live demo at the Computer History Museum, of an IBM 1401 playing music via AM radio bus emissions.
